Every state read /     write goes through PCS. Lazy-settlement model (preserved 1:1 from the legacy stateful NFT):   - Each account lifetime is divided into `lockDurationEpochs` billing     windows of length `Chronos.epochLength()`, anchored at     `Account.createdAtTimestamp`. Per-window base budget is     `B = committedTRAC / lockDurationEpochs`.   - Two sinks drain `B` per window:       1. ACTIVE: `coverPublishingCost` distributes its          `discountedCost` across the published KA's epoch range via          `EpochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange`. The base portion drawn          increments `windowSpent[id][w]`, capped at `B`.       2. PASSIVE: at the end of window `w`, the unspent remainder          `B - windowSpent[w]` is swept to the staker reward pool for          the chain epochs that window overlaps. Settlement is lazy:          triggered by the next `coverPublishingCost`, `topUp`,          ERC-721 transfer (via `onTransfer`), or an explicit public          `settle(accountId)` call.   - `topUpBalance[accountId]` is a separate prepaid usage buffer     beyond the base budget. It is drawn only when the current     window's base allowance is exhausted. Any leftover at account     expiry is swept to the staker pool (final chain epoch) via the     same `settle()` path.   - Invariant: over a full account lifetime, the total TRAC drained     from the escrowed `committedTRAC + sum(topUps)` is conserved and     splits into exactly two destinations:       (a) the staker reward pool, credited via           `EpochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange(STAKER_SHARD_ID, ...)`, and       (b) the protocol treasury, paid via           `ConvictionStakingStorage.transferStake(protocolTreasury, fee)`. While `protocolTreasury == address(0)` the fee is 0 and the     whole amount flows to the pool (legacy behaviour). Any     `committedTRAC % lockDurationEpochs` dust is swept on the final     settle alongside the topUp tail. A trusted caller cannot pass a victim's accountId.   - `settle(accountId)` is intentionally permissionless \u2014 any account     (including a staker pool watcher) can flush pending sweeps. We only update accounting state.\n     */\n    function topUp(\n        address /* owner */,\n        uint256 accountId,\n        uint96 amount\n    ) external onlyConvictionNFT {\n        if (amount == 0) revert InvalidAmount();\n\n        PublishingConvictionStorage.Account memory acct =\n            publishingConvictionStorage.getAccount(accountId);\n\n        if (block.timestamp >= uint256(acct.expiresAtTimestamp)) {\n            revert AccountExpired(accountId, acct.expiresAtEpoch);\n        }\n\n        _settleElapsed(acct, accountId);\n\n        publishingConvictionStorage.increaseTopUpBalance(accountId, amount);\n\n        emit ToppedUp(accountId, amount, publishingConvictionStorage.topUpBalance(accountId));\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //              Publishing-cost coverage (active sink)\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Charge a publishing agent's conviction allowance for\n     *         `baseCost` and fund the published KA's epoch range from\n     *         the escrowed TRAC sitting in the CSS vault.\n     *\n     * @dev Authorization (N28-fixed):\n     *        - `onlyConvictionNFT`: this function may only be invoked by\n     *          the NFT wrapper. KAV10 calls the NFT, the NFT validates\n     *          KAV10 as the outer caller, and the NFT forwards here.\n     *        - The publishing agent's accountId is resolved from PCS's\n     *          `agentToAccountId` map; KAV10 cannot pass a victim's\n     *          accountId.\n     *\n     *      Behavior \u2014 preserved 1:1 from the legacy stateful NFT:\n     *        1. Reject if the publish's KA lifetime (`kaEpochs`) exceeds\n     *           the account's `lockDurationEpochs`.\n     *        2. Lazily settle elapsed billing windows (passive sink).\n     *        3. Compute `discountedCost = baseCost * (1 - discountBps/1e4)`.\n     *        4. Spend order against the current window: base allowance\n     *           first, then `topUpBalance` overflow.\n     *        5. Distribute the discounted cost across the KA's epoch\n     *           range via `EpochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange` \u2014\n     *           prorating the partial first and last chain epoch.\n     *\n     *      Does NOT physically move TRAC; the escrowed amount is already\n     *      in the CSS vault from `createAccount` / `topUp`. Returns the\n     *      discounted amount for KAV10's internal accounting.\n     */\n    function coverPublishingCost(\n        address publishingAgent,\n        uint96 baseCost,\n        uint40 kaStartEpoch,\n        uint40 kaEpochs\n    ) external onlyConvictionNFT returns (uint96 discountedCost) {\n        uint256 accountId = publishingConvictionStorage.agentToAccountId(publishingAgent);\n        if (accountId == 0) revert NoConvictionAccount(publishingAgent);\n\n        PublishingConvictionStorage.Account memory acct =\n            publishingConvictionStorage.getAccount(accountId);\n\n        if (block.timestamp >= uint256(acct.expiresAtTimestamp)) {\n            revert AccountExpired(accountId, acct.expiresAtEpoch);\n        }\n        if (kaEpochs == 0 || kaEpochs > uint40(acct.lockDurationEpochs)) {\n            revert InvalidConvictionKaEpochs(uint256(acct.lockDurationEpochs), uint256(kaEpochs));\n        }\n\n        // Re-read after settle: `_settleElapsed` may have advanced\n        // `lastSettledWindow` on storage. We don't actually depend on the\n        // updated cursor below (`currentBillingWindow` is independent of\n        // it), but keeping the in-memory snapshot consistent with storage\n        // avoids surprises if future logic adds a dependency.\n        _settleElapsed(acct, accountId);\n\n        uint40 currentEpoch = uint40(chronos.getCurrentEpoch());\n        uint40 currentBillingWindow = _currentBillingWindow(acct);\n\n        discountedCost = uint96(\n            (uint256(baseCost) * (BPS_DENOMINATOR - uint256(acct.discountBps))) / BPS_DENOMINATOR\n        );\n        // Post-discount floor \u2014 mirror of the on-chain `tokenAmount > 0`\n        // floor on the direct-spend branch (KAV10 10.1.1). Integer\n        // truncation in the discount math collapses any\n        // `baseCost * (BPS_DENOMINATOR - discountBps) < BPS_DENOMINATOR`\n        // case (most concretely: `baseCost == 1` with any non-zero\n        // discount on the 6-tier ladder) to `discountedCost == 0`, which\n        // would skip both window-spent accounting AND the active-sink\n        // reward distribution \u2014 i.e. a free conviction-discounted\n        // publish. KAV10's base-amount floor only protects the\n        // direct-spend branch; this is its conviction-branch twin.\n        // Guard with `baseCost > 0` so the trivially-honest\n        // `coverPublishingCost(_, 0, _, _)` shape (no path exercises it\n        // today; defensive) stays a no-op instead of being inflated to 1.\n        if (discountedCost == 0 && baseCost > 0) {\n            discountedCost = 1;\n        }\n\n        uint96 baseAllowance = acct.committedTRAC / uint96(acct.lockDurationEpochs);\n        uint96 spent = publishingConvictionStorage.windowSpent(accountId, currentBillingWindow);\n        uint96 epochRemaining = spent < baseAllowance ? baseAllowance - spent : 0;\n\n        uint96 drawnFromEpoch;\n        uint96 drawnFromTopUp;\n\n        if (discountedCost <= epochRemaining) {\n            drawnFromEpoch = discountedCost;\n        } else {\n            drawnFromEpoch = epochRemaining;\n            uint96 shortfall = discountedCost - epochRemaining;\n            uint96 buffer = publishingConvictionStorage.topUpBalance(accountId);\n            if (shortfall > buffer) {\n                revert InsufficientAllowance(\n                    accountId,\n                    currentEpoch,\n                    discountedCost,\n                    epochRemaining + buffer\n                );\n            }\n            drawnFromTopUp = shortfall;\n            publishingConvictionStorage.decreaseTopUpBalance(accountId, shortfall);\n        }\n\n        if (drawnFromEpoch > 0) {\n            publishingConvictionStorage.increaseWindowSpent(accountId, currentBillingWindow, drawnFromEpoch);\n        }\n\n        // Active sink: fund the KA's epoch range with the discounted\n        // cost. MUST mirror `KnowledgeAssetsV10._distributeTokens`\n        // semantics so conviction-funded and direct-spend reward curves\n        // are identical (modulo the conviction discount).\n        uint96 distributed = drawnFromEpoch + drawnFromTopUp;\n        if (distributed > 0) {\n            (address treasury, uint256 feeBps) = _treasuryParams();\n            uint96 fee = _feeOf(distributed, feeBps);\n            uint96 net = distributed - fee;\n            if (net > 0) {\n                _distributeProrated(net, kaStartEpoch, uint256(kaEpochs));\n            }\n            // PCS window/topUp writes (above) are already persisted, so\n            // paying the treasury last keeps effects-before-interactions.\n            _payTreasury(treasury, fee);\n        }\n\n        emit CostCovered(accountId, currentEpoch, baseCost, discountedCost, drawnFromEpoch, drawnFromTopUp);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Mirrors `KnowledgeAssetsV10._distributeTokens` exactly so\n    ///      conviction-funded reward curves match direct-spend curves.\n    ///      Splits `amount` across `storageUnits + 1` chain epochs\n    ///      starting at `firstEpoch`: the partial first epoch gets a\n    ///      time-weighted slice, the middle full epochs each get the\n    ///      base, and the partial tail epoch absorbs the remainder\n    ///      (including any rounding dust).\n    function _distributeProrated(\n        uint96 amount,\n        uint40 firstEpoch,\n        uint256 storageUnits\n    ) internal {\n        uint256 epochLengthSec = chronos.epochLength();\n        uint256 timeRemainingInCurrentEpoch = chronos.timeUntilNextEpoch();\n        PublishingMathLib.ActiveSinkRange[3] memory ranges = PublishingMathLib.prorateActiveSink(\n            amount,\n            firstEpoch,\n            storageUnits,\n            epochLengthSec,\n            timeRemainingInCurrentEpoch\n        );\n\n        for (uint256 i; i < ranges.length; i++) {\n            if (ranges[i].tokenAmount == 0) continue;\n            epochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange(\n                STAKER_SHARD_ID,\n                ranges[i].startEpoch,\n                ranges[i].endEpoch,\n                ranges[i].tokenAmount\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                  Protocol treasury fee\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @dev Snapshot the treasury config once per settlement so the per-\n    ///      window loops in `_settleElapsed` / `_finalSweep` don't pay a\n    ///      cross-contract read on every iteration. Returns\n    ///      `(address(0), 0)` while the fee is disabled (no treasury\n    ///      wired), which makes `_feeOf` a no-op and `_payTreasury` skip.\n    function _treasuryParams() internal view returns (address treasury, uint256 bps) {\n        treasury = parametersStorage.protocolTreasury();\n        if (treasury == address(0)) return (address(0), 0);\n        bps = uint256(parametersStorage.protocolTreasuryFee());\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Treasury fee (TRAC) for a single staker-bound `amount` given a\n    ///      pre-read `bps`. `bps` is capped at\n    ///      `ParametersStorage.MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE` (10%), so the\n    ///      returned fee never exceeds `amount` and `amount - fee` cannot\n    ///      underflow.\n    function _feeOf(uint96 amount, uint256 bps) internal pure returns (uint96) {\n        if (bps == 0) return 0;\n        return uint96((uint256(amount) * bps) / BPS_DENOMINATOR);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Pay an accumulated treasury `totalFee` out of the escrowed\n    ///      conviction TRAC. MUST be the LAST statement in any function\n    ///      that mutated PCS state: this `transferStake` is the only\n    ///      external-call reentrancy surface on the permissionless\n    ///      `settle()` path, and running it after the settlement cursor /\n    ///      `fullySwept` flag are persisted makes any re-entry a no-op.\n    function _payTreasury(address treasury, uint96 totalFee) internal {\n        if (totalFee == 0 || treasury == address(0)) return;\n        convictionStakingStorage.transferStake(treasury, totalFee);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //          Lazy settlement (passive sink + final tail)\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Public lazy-settlement entry point. Permissionless: anyone\n     *         (account owner, staker pool watcher, automation bot) can\n     *         flush pending sweeps. Idempotent \u2014 subsequent calls after\n     *         the post-expiry final sweep are no-ops.\n     *\n     * @dev Flow:\n     *        - Pre-expiry: sweeps every elapsed billing window's unspent\n     *          base remainder (`B - windowSpent[w]`) into the staker\n     *          pool, prorated across the chain epochs the window\n     *          overlaps.\n     *        - Post-expiry: in addition to the above, finalises the\n     *          last window, sweeps any leftover `topUpBalance`, and\n     *          sweeps `committedTRAC % lockDurationEpochs` dust to the\n     *          final chain epoch. Sets `fullySwept = true`.\n     *\n     *      No `onlyConvictionNFT` gate \u2014 public on purpose. Accounts\n     *      that have never been created revert via PCS's\n     *      `getAccount(...)` underflow path. `fullySwept` accounts\n     *      short-circuit before any work.\n     */\n    function settle(uint256 accountId) external {\n        if (!publishingConvictionStorage.accountExists(accountId)) {\n            revert UnknownAccount(accountId);\n        }\n        PublishingConvictionStorage.Account memory acct =\n            publishingConvictionStorage.getAccount(accountId);\n        if (acct.fullySwept) return;\n\n        _settleElapsed(acct, accountId);\n\n        if (block.timestamp >= uint256(acct.expiresAtTimestamp)) {\n            _finalSweep(acct, accountId);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Trigger lazy-settlement from the NFT wrapper's transfer\n    ///         hook AND clear every agent registration so the new owner\n    ///         starts with a clean slate. Restricted to the NFT.\n    /// @dev    `from`/`to` arguments are not used internally \u2014 the\n    ///         wrapper passes them so a future audit-friendly extension\n    ///         (e.g. emitting a wrapper-layer transfer-settle event with\n    ///         both endpoints) does not require an interface change.\n    function onTransfer(\n        uint256 accountId,\n        address /* from */,\n        address /* to */\n    ) external onlyConvictionNFT {\n        PublishingConvictionStorage.Account memory acct =\n            publishingConvictionStorage.getAccount(accountId);\n        if (acct.lockDurationEpochs != 0 && !acct.fullySwept) {\n            _settleElapsed(acct, accountId);\n            if (block.timestamp >= uint256(acct.expiresAtTimestamp)) {\n                _finalSweep(acct, accountId);\n            }\n        }\n        publishingConvictionStorage.clearAgents(accountId);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Internal helper: sweep all CLOSED windows up to the\n    ///         current window into the staker pool. Idempotent and\n    ///         gas-bounded by `lockDurationEpochs - lastSettledWindow`.\n    /// @dev    Mutates `acct.lastSettledWindow` in memory so callers\n    ///         (e.g. `topUp`, `coverPublishingCost`) see a consistent\n    ///         snapshot after the call. The single SSTORE to PCS at\n    ///         the end keeps gas costs predictable.\n    function _settleElapsed(\n        PublishingConvictionStorage.Account memory acct,\n        uint256 accountId\n    ) internal {\n        uint40 currentWindow = _currentBillingWindow(acct);\n        uint40 maxWindow = uint40(acct.lockDurationEpochs);\n        uint40 stopAt = currentWindow < maxWindow ? currentWindow : maxWindow;\n\n        if (uint40(acct.lastSettledWindow) >= stopAt) return;\n\n        // Slither divide-before-multiply \u2014 `committedTRAC / lockDurationEpochs`\n        // executes BEFORE `_feeOf(remainder, feeBps)`'s multiplication. The\n        // truncation here is bounded:\n        //\n        //   * per-window rounding error \u2264 (lockDurationEpochs \u2212 1) wei\n        //     because integer division truncates the remainder.\n        //   * cumulative rounding error over an entire lock cycle \u2264\n        //     lockDurationEpochs\u00b2 wei. For the practical maximum of\n        //     lockDurationEpochs = 365 (one-year locks), that ceiling is\n        //     365\u00b2 \u2248 1.3 \u00d7 10\u2075 wei = 1.3 \u00d7 10\u207b\u00b9\u00b3 TRAC. Negligible\n        //     against any plausible TRAC balance or treasury fee.\n        //\n        // Re-ordering the operations to multiply first would require\n        // widening intermediate types to uint256 and adds gas without\n        // changing the on-chain payout to any observable precision.\n        // slither-disable-next-line divide-before-multiply\n        uint96 baseAllowance = acct.committedTRAC / uint96(acct.lockDurationEpochs);\n\n        (address treasury, uint256 feeBps) = _treasuryParams();\n        uint96 accruedFee;\n\n        for (uint40 w = uint40(acct.lastSettledWindow); w < stopAt; w++) {\n            uint96 spent = publishingConvictionStorage.windowSpent(accountId, w);\n            uint96 remainder = spent < baseAllowance ? baseAllowance - spent : 0;\n            (uint40 startEp, uint40 endEp) = _windowChainEpochRange(acct, w);\n            if (remainder > 0) {\n                uint96 fee = _feeOf(remainder, feeBps);\n                accruedFee += fee;\n                uint96 net = remainder - fee;\n                if (net > 0) {\n                    _sweepWindowProrated(acct, w, startEp, endEp, net);\n                }\n            }\n            // `remainderSwept` stays gross (net to pool + fee to treasury).\n            emit WindowSettled(accountId, w, startEp, endEp, remainder);\n        }\n\n        acct.lastSettledWindow = uint16(stopAt);\n        publishingConvictionStorage.setLastSettledWindow(accountId, uint16(stopAt));\n\n        // Effects (cursor SSTORE) complete; pay the treasury last so the\n        // permissionless `settle()` entry point is reentrancy-safe.\n        _payTreasury(treasury, accruedFee);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Distribute `amount` across the chain-epoch range\n    ///      `[startEp, endEp]` that billing window `w` of `acct`\n    ///      overlaps, proportional to wall-clock seconds shared with\n    ///      each chain epoch. A billing window is exactly\n    ///      `epochLength()` long, so it overlaps AT MOST two chain\n    ///      epochs (single chain epoch or one straddle).\n    function _sweepWindowProrated(\n        PublishingConvictionStorage.Account memory acct,\n        uint40 w,\n        uint40 startEp,\n        uint40 endEp,\n        uint96 amount\n    ) internal {\n        if (startEp == endEp) {\n            epochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange(\n                STAKER_SHARD_ID,\n                uint256(startEp),\n                uint256(endEp),\n                amount\n            );\n            return;\n        }\n        uint256 epochLengthSec = chronos.epochLength();\n        uint256 winStartTs = uint256(acct.createdAtTimestamp) + uint256(w) * epochLengthSec;\n        uint256 boundaryTs = chronos.timestampForEpoch(uint256(endEp));\n        uint256 startOverlap = boundaryTs - winStartTs;\n        uint96 startAllocation = uint96((uint256(amount) * startOverlap) / epochLengthSec);\n        uint96 endAllocation = amount - startAllocation;\n        if (startAllocation > 0) {\n            epochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange(\n                STAKER_SHARD_ID,\n                uint256(startEp),\n                uint256(startEp),\n                startAllocation\n            );\n        }\n        if (endAllocation > 0) {\n            epochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange(\n                STAKER_SHARD_ID,\n                uint256(endEp),\n                uint256(endEp),\n                endAllocation\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Post-expiry final sweep. Assumes\n    ///         `block.timestamp >= acct.expiresAtTimestamp`. Settles\n    ///         any windows `_settleElapsed` left for the final one,\n    ///         then sweeps `topUpBalance` and dust to the final chain\n    ///         epoch. Marks `fullySwept = true`.\n    function _finalSweep(\n        PublishingConvictionStorage.Account memory acct,\n        uint256 accountId\n    ) internal {\n        if (acct.fullySwept) return;\n\n        uint40 maxWindow = uint40(acct.lockDurationEpochs);\n        uint96 baseAllowance = acct.committedTRAC / uint96(acct.lockDurationEpochs);\n\n        (address treasury, uint256 feeBps) = _treasuryParams();\n        uint96 accruedFee;\n\n        for (uint40 w = uint40(acct.lastSettledWindow); w < maxWindow; w++) {\n            uint96 spent = publishingConvictionStorage.windowSpent(accountId, w);\n            uint96 remainder = spent < baseAllowance ? baseAllowance - spent : 0;\n            (uint40 startEp, uint40 endEp) = _windowChainEpochRange(acct, w);\n            if (remainder > 0) {\n                uint96 fee = _feeOf(remainder, feeBps);\n                accruedFee += fee;\n                uint96 net = remainder - fee;\n                if (net > 0) {\n                    _sweepWindowProrated(acct, w, startEp, endEp, net);\n                }\n            }\n            emit WindowSettled(accountId, w, startEp, endEp, remainder);\n        }\n        acct.lastSettledWindow = uint16(maxWindow);\n        publishingConvictionStorage.setLastSettledWindow(accountId, uint16(maxWindow));\n\n        uint40 finalChainEpoch = uint40(\n            chronos.epochAtTimestamp(uint256(acct.expiresAtTimestamp) - 1)\n        );\n        uint96 dust = acct.committedTRAC - baseAllowance * uint96(acct.lockDurationEpochs);\n        uint96 leftoverTopUp = publishingConvictionStorage.topUpBalance(accountId);\n        uint96 tailSweep = dust + leftoverTopUp;\n        if (tailSweep > 0) {\n            uint96 tailFee = _feeOf(tailSweep, feeBps);\n            accruedFee += tailFee;\n            uint96 tailNet = tailSweep - tailFee;\n            if (tailNet > 0) {\n                epochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange(\n                    STAKER_SHARD_ID,\n                    uint256(finalChainEpoch),\n                    uint256(finalChainEpoch),\n                    tailNet\n                );\n            }\n        }\n        if (leftoverTopUp > 0) {\n            publishingConvictionStorage.clearTopUpBalance(accountId);\n        }\n\n        publishingConvictionStorage.setFullySwept(accountId, true);\n        emit AccountFinalSwept(accountId, leftoverTopUp, dust);\n\n        // All PCS state (cursor, topUp clear, fullySwept) is persisted;\n        // pay the treasury last for `settle()` reentrancy safety.\n        _payTreasury(treasury, accruedFee);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                  Window-index helpers (views)\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @dev Internal: current billing-window index for `acct`. Anchored\n    ///      at `acct.createdAtTimestamp`; window length matches\n    ///      `Chronos.epochLength()`.\n    function _currentBillingWindow(\n        PublishingConvictionStorage.Account memory acct\n    ) internal view returns (uint40) {\n        if (block.timestamp <= uint256(acct.createdAtTimestamp)) return 0;\n        return uint40(\n            (block.timestamp - uint256(acct.createdAtTimestamp)) / chronos.epochLength()\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Public view: current billing-window index, capped at\n    ///         `lockDurationEpochs` (i.e. \"no more active windows\").\n    function getCurrentBillingWindow(uint256 accountId) external view returns (uint40) {\n        PublishingConvictionStorage.Account memory acct =\n            publishingConvictionStorage.getAccount(accountId);\n        uint40 maxWindow = uint40(acct.lockDurationEpochs);\n        uint40 current = _currentBillingWindow(acct);\n        return current < maxWindow ? current : maxWindow;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Internal: chain-epoch range overlapping billing window `w`.\n    function _windowChainEpochRange(\n        PublishingConvictionStorage.Account memory acct,\n        uint40 w\n    ) internal view returns (uint40 startEp, uint40 endEp) {\n        uint256 epLen = chronos.epochLength();\n        uint256 winStartTs = uint256(acct.createdAtTimestamp) + uint256(w) * epLen;\n        uint256 winEndTs = winStartTs + epLen - 1;\n        startEp = uint40(chronos.epochAtTimestamp(winStartTs));\n        endEp = uint40(chronos.epochAtTimestamp(winEndTs));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Public view: chain-epoch range that billing-window `w`\n    ///         of `accountId` overlaps. Useful for off-chain reporting.\n    function getWindowChainEpochRange(uint256 accountId, uint40 w)\n        external\n        view\n        returns (uint40 startEp, uint40 endEp)\n    {\n        PublishingConvictionStorage.Account memory acct =\n            publishingConvictionStorage.getAccount(accountId);\n        return _windowChainEpochRange(acct, w);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Remaining allowance (base + topUp) for `accountId` in\n    ///         a given chain `epoch`. Returns 0 outside the account's\n    ///         active lifetime.\n    function getRemainingAllowance(uint256 accountId, uint40 epoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        PublishingConvictionStorage.Account memory acct =\n            publishingConvictionStorage.getAccount(accountId);\n        if (epoch < acct.createdAtEpoch || epoch >= acct.expiresAtEpoch) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        uint256 epochStartTimestamp = chronos.timestampForEpoch(epoch);\n        uint40 billingWindow;\n        if (epochStartTimestamp <= uint256(acct.createdAtTimestamp)) {\n            billingWindow = 0;\n        } else {\n            billingWindow = uint40(\n                (epochStartTimestamp - uint256(acct.createdAtTimestamp)) / chronos.epochLength()\n            );\n        }\n        uint96 baseAllowance = acct.committedTRAC / uint96(acct.lockDurationEpochs);\n        uint96 spent = publishingConvictionStorage.windowSpent(accountId, billingWindow);\n        uint96 epochRemaining = spent < baseAllowance ? baseAllowance - spent : 0;\n        return epochRemaining + publishingConvictionStorage.topUpBalance(accountId);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                  Agent management\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @notice Append `agent` to `accountId`. Cap, zero-address, and\n    ///         already-registered checks are enforced here; PCS\n    ///         performs the atomic write.\n    /// @dev    Owner-validation lives on the NFT wrapper, which calls\n    ///         this function with `owner` for symmetry with future\n    ///         audit-friendly extensions. The argument is intentionally\n    ///         unused here to avoid double-validating ownership across\n    ///         contracts.\n    function registerAgent(\n        address /* owner */,\n        uint256 accountId,\n        address agent\n    ) external onlyConvictionNFT {\n        if (agent == address(0)) revert ZeroAgentAddress();\n\n        uint256 cap = publishingConvictionStorage.maxAgentsPerAccount();\n        if (publishingConvictionStorage.agentCount(accountId) >= cap) {\n            revert AgentCapReached(accountId, cap);\n        }\n\n        publishingConvictionStorage.addAgent(accountId, agent);\n        emit AgentRegistered(accountId, agent);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Remove `agent` from `accountId`. PCS reverts if not\n    ///         registered.\n    function deregisterAgent(\n        address /* owner */,\n        uint256 accountId,\n        address agent\n    ) external onlyConvictionNFT {\n        publishingConvictionStorage.removeAgent(accountId, agent);\n        emit AgentDeregistered(accountId, agent);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                  Discount tier ladder\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @notice Discrete 6-tier discount ladder. Tiers are evaluated\n    ///         highest-first so the largest commit that qualifies is\n    ///         selected.\n    function getDiscountBps(uint96 committedTRAC) public pure returns (uint256) {\n        return PublishingMathLib.discountBps(committedTRAC);\n Clamp,\n        // don't revert: lazy past-window settlement is an intended pattern.\n        uint256 firstOpenEpoch = lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] + 1;\n        if (startEpoch < firstOpenEpoch) {\n 1;\n\n        uint96 totalTokens = tokenAmount + accumulatedRemainder[shardId];\n        uint96 tokensPerEpochU = uint96(totalTokens / numEpochs);\n        uint96 remainder = uint96(totalTokens % numEpochs);\n\n        accumulatedRemainder[shardId] = remainder;\n\n        int96 tokensPerEpoch = int96(tokensPerEpochU);\n\n        diff[shardId][startEpoch] += tokensPerEpoch;\n        diff[shardId][endEpoch + 1] -= tokensPerEpoch;\n\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch > 1) {\n            _finalizeEpochsUpTo(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n        }\n\n        emit TokensAddedToEpochRange(shardId, startEpoch, endEpoch, tokenAmount, remainder);\n    }\n\n    function payOutEpochTokens(\n        uint256 shardId,\n        uint256 epoch,\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint96 amount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch > 1) {\n Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {ICustodian} from \"../interfaces/ICustodian.sol\";\n\ncontract ParametersStorage is INamed, IVersioned, HubDependent {\n    event ParameterChanged(string parameterName, uint256 parameterValue);\n    /// @notice Emitted when the protocol treasury recipient changes. The\n    ///         address is carried in its own event (rather than the\n    ///         `uint256`-valued `ParameterChanged`) so off-chain indexers get a\n    ///         typed `address` field.\n    event ProtocolTreasurySet(address indexed treasury);\n\n    error ZeroShardingTableSizeLimit();\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"ParametersStorage\";\n    // protocol treasury fee (`protocolTreasuryFee`, `protocolTreasury`,\n    // `MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE`) skimmed from the staker-bound TRAC on\n    // every paid publish / update / lifetime-extension.\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.4\";\n\n    uint96 public minimumStake;\n    uint96 public maximumStake;\n\n    uint256 public stakeWithdrawalDelay;\n    uint256 public nodeAskUpdateDelay;\n    uint256 public operatorFeeUpdateDelay;\n\n    uint16 public opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation;\n    uint16 public shardingTableSizeLimit;\n\n    uint256 public minimumRequiredSignatures;\n\n    uint256 public askUpperBoundFactor;\n    uint256 public askLowerBoundFactor;\n\n    uint16 public maxOperatorFee;\n\n    uint256 public v81ReleaseEpoch;\n    uint256 public publishingConvictionEpochs;\n\n    /// @notice Protocol treasury fee in basis points (out of 10_000) skimmed\n    ///         from the staker-bound TRAC on every paid publish / update /\n    ///         lifetime-extension. The fee is taken out of the amount that\n    ///         would otherwise flow to the staker reward pool \u2014 it does NOT\n    ///         change the price a publisher pays. Default 300 (3%).\n    ///\n    ///         The fee is a no-op while `protocolTreasury == address(0)`\n    ///         (the full amount flows to stakers), so it stays dormant until\n    ///         governance wires a treasury recipient via `setProtocolTreasury`.\n    uint16 public protocolTreasuryFee;\n\n    /// @notice Recipient of the protocol treasury fee. The zero address\n    ///         disables the fee entirely regardless of `protocolTreasuryFee`.\n    address public protocolTreasury;\n\n    /// @notice Minimum TRAC deposit required to register a Context Graph\n    ///         on-chain (`ContextGraphs.createContextGraph`). The deposit is\n    ///         held as the CG's prepaid publishing escrow \u2014 spendable by the\n    ///         CG owner on publish/update/extend into that CG \u2014 and is never\n    ///         cash-refundable (residue sweeps to the staker reward pool on\n    ///         deactivation). Anti-spam for the unbounded-CG-creation DoS\n    ///         (OT-RFC-53). Setting it to 0 disables the deposit (dormant).\n    uint96 public contextGraphRegistrationDeposit;\n\n    /// @notice Hard upper bound on `protocolTreasuryFee` (10%). Bounds\n    ///         governance so the fee can never be set to an extractive level\n    ///         that would starve the staker reward pool.\n    uint16 public constant MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE = 1_000;\n\n    /// @notice Hard upper bound on `publishingConvictionEpochs`.\n    ///\n    /// `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT._settleElapsed` / `_finalSweep` loop\n    /// `lockDurationEpochs` times in the worst case (dormant account\n    /// settled at expiry). Each iteration costs ~30\u201350k gas\n    /// (`windowSpent` SLOAD + one or two `epochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange`\n    /// writes + a `WindowSettled` event), so an unbounded\n    /// `publishingConvictionEpochs` (the previous cap was `uint16.max`)\n    /// would let governance brick PCAs by setting the parameter past\n    /// the block-gas budget. 60 chain epochs \u2248 5 years at a 1-month\n    /// epoch length and worst-cases at ~3M gas \u2014 comfortably below\n    /// the block limit while leaving room for the surrounding\n    /// `publish` / `topUp` / NFT-transfer work.\n    uint256 public constant MAX_PUBLISHING_CONVICTION_EPOCHS = 60;\n\n    // @dev Only transactions by HubController owner or one of the owners of the MultiSig Wallet\n    modifier onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() {\n        _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner();\n        _;\n    }\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress, uint256 _v81ReleaseEpoch) HubDependent(hubAddress) {\n        minimumStake = 50_000 ether;\n        maximumStake = 10_000_000 ether;\n\n        stakeWithdrawalDelay = 28 days;\n        nodeAskUpdateDelay = 1 days;\n        operatorFeeUpdateDelay = 28 days;\n\n        opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation = 50;\n        shardingTableSizeLimit = 500;\n\n        minimumRequiredSignatures = 3;\n\n        askUpperBoundFactor = 1467000000000000000;\n        askLowerBoundFactor = 533000000000000000;\n\n        maxOperatorFee = 10_000;\n\n        // Epoch when v8.1 was released on mainnet/testnet\n        // Change if you ever redeploy delegatorsInfo contract on either network\n        v81ReleaseEpoch = _v81ReleaseEpoch;\n        publishingConvictionEpochs = 12;\n\n        // 3% default. Dormant until `protocolTreasury` is set (defaults to\n        // the zero address), so a fresh deploy behaves exactly as before\n        // until governance opts in.\n        protocolTreasuryFee = 300;\n\n        // OT-RFC-53: constructor leaves the registration deposit at 0; the\n        // standard deploy sets the live value (100 TRAC) via a post-deploy\n        // script that calls `setContextGraphRegistrationDeposit`. This protects\n        // production automatically (no manual step, no silent-off) while keeping\n        // test fixtures \u2014 which don't run that script \u2014 unaffected. Governance\n        // can retune or disable it anytime.\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function setAskUpperBoundFactor(uint256 _askUpperBoundFactor) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        askUpperBoundFactor = _askUpperBoundFactor;\n    }\n\n    function setAskLowerBoundFactor(uint256 _askLowerBoundFactor) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        askLowerBoundFactor = _askLowerBoundFactor;\n    }\n\n    function setMinimumRequiredSignatures(uint256 _minimumRequiredSignatures) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        minimumRequiredSignatures = _minimumRequiredSignatures;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"minimumRequiredSignatures\", _minimumRequiredSignatures);\n    }\n\n    function setMinimumStake(uint96 newMinimumStake) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        minimumStake = newMinimumStake;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"minimumStake\", newMinimumStake);\n    }\n\n    function setMaximumStake(uint96 newMaximumStake) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        maximumStake = newMaximumStake;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"maximumStake\", newMaximumStake);\n    }\n\n    function setStakeWithdrawalDelay(uint256 newStakeWithdrawalDelay) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        stakeWithdrawalDelay = newStakeWithdrawalDelay;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"stakeWithdrawalDelay\", newStakeWithdrawalDelay);\n    }\n\n    function setNodeAskUpdateDelay(uint256 newNodeAskUpdateDelay) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        nodeAskUpdateDelay = newNodeAskUpdateDelay;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"nodeAskUpdateDelay\", newNodeAskUpdateDelay);\n    }\n\n    function setOperatorFeeUpdateDelay(uint256 newOperatorFeeUpdateDelay) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        operatorFeeUpdateDelay = newOperatorFeeUpdateDelay;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"operatorFeeUpdateDelay\", newOperatorFeeUpdateDelay);\n    }\n\n    function setOpWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation(\n        uint16 opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation_\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation = opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation\", opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation);\n    }\n\n    function setShardingTableSizeLimit(uint16 shardingTableSizeLimit_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        // Reject 0: ShardingTable._insertNode now enforces this cap\n        // (`nodesCount >= limit` reverts ShardingTableIsFull), so a 0 limit would\n        // freeze ALL node admission (even the first insert), bricking staking. 0\n        // is never a meaningful table size \u2014 reject it rather than let it act as\n        // an implicit pause switch.\n        if (shardingTableSizeLimit_ == 0) revert ZeroShardingTableSizeLimit();\n        shardingTableSizeLimit = shardingTableSizeLimit_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"shardingTableSizeLimit\", shardingTableSizeLimit);\n    }\n\n    function setMaxOperatorFee(uint16 maxOperatorFee_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        maxOperatorFee = maxOperatorFee_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"maxOperatorFee\", maxOperatorFee);\n    }\n\n    function setV81ReleaseEpoch(uint256 _v81ReleaseEpoch) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        v81ReleaseEpoch = _v81ReleaseEpoch;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"v81ReleaseEpoch\", _v81ReleaseEpoch);\n    }\n\n    function setPublishingConvictionEpochs(\n        uint256 _publishingConvictionEpochs\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        require(_publishingConvictionEpochs > 0, \"publishingConvictionEpochs must be > 0\");\n        // See `MAX_PUBLISHING_CONVICTION_EPOCHS` for the gas-budget\n        // rationale. The previous `<= type(uint16).max` bound permitted\n        // values that would gas-out PCA settlement.\n        require(\n            _publishingConvictionEpochs <= MAX_PUBLISHING_CONVICTION_EPOCHS,\n            \"publishingConvictionEpochs too large\"\n        );\n        publishingConvictionEpochs = _publishingConvictionEpochs;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"publishingConvictionEpochs\", _publishingConvictionEpochs);\n    }\n\n    function setContextGraphRegistrationDeposit(uint96 amount) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        contextGraphRegistrationDeposit = amount;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"contextGraphRegistrationDeposit\", amount);\n    }\n\n    function setProtocolTreasuryFee(uint16 protocolTreasuryFee_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        // See `MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE` for the rationale on the upper\n        // bound. 0 is allowed (disables the fee while keeping the recipient\n        // wired) \u2014 the floor is enforced implicitly by the unsigned type.\n        require(protocolTreasuryFee_ <= MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE, \"protocolTreasuryFee too large\");\n        protocolTreasuryFee = protocolTreasuryFee_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"protocolTreasuryFee\", protocolTreasuryFee_);\n    }\n\n    function setProtocolTreasury(address protocolTreasury_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        protocolTreasury = protocolTreasury_;\n\n        emit ProtocolTreasurySet(protocolTreasury_);\n    }\n\n    function _isMultiSigOwner(address multiSigAddress) internal view returns (bool) {\n        // First check if the address has contract code\n        uint256 size;\n        assembly {\n            size := extcodesize(multiSigAddress)\n        }\n\n        // If no contract code, it's an EOA, not a multisig\n        if (size == 0) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        try ICustodian(multiSigAddress).getOwners() returns (address[] memory multiSigOwners) {\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < multiSigOwners.length; i++) {\n                if (msg.sender == multiSigOwners[i]) {\n                    return true;\n                }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            // Not a multisig or call reverted; treat as not owner.\n        }\n\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    function _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() internal view virtual {\n        address hubOwner = hub.owner();\n        if (msg.sender != hubOwner && msg.sender != address(hub) && !_isMultiSigOwner(hubOwner)) {\n            revert(\"Only Hub Owner, Hub, or Multisig Owner can call\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xcfa8ee19dacc2be0de28973802d18037bfac66537db226afc21d259611c5bac2","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/PublishingConvictionStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {IInitializable} from \"../interfaces/IInitializable.sol\";\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title PublishingConvictionStorage\n * @notice Single source of truth for V10 publisher conviction account state.\n *\n * Architecture (mirrors the V10 staking split \u2014 `ConvictionStakingStorage`\n * holds positions, `StakingV10` is stateless logic, `DKGStakingConvictionNFT`\n * is a thin ERC-721 wrapper):\n *\n *   - `PublishingConvictionStorage` (this contract) owns every byte of\n *     application state for publisher conviction accounts: the `Account`\n *     struct keyed by `accountId`, per-billing-window TRAC accounting\n *     (`windowSpent`), the persistent top-up buffer (`topUpBalance`), the\n *     agent registration tables, and the governance-tunable\n *     `maxAgentsPerAccount` cap.\n *\n *     This is a fresh-state contract: it ships EMPTY at deploy time\n *     and there is NO automated migration path that copies state out\n *     of the legacy combined `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT` v2.x. PCA\n *     accounts opened against the v2.x contract are NOT readable here\n *     after the upgrade. This is intentional and matches how the V10\n *     line has handled prior storage-split redeploys\n *     (`ProfileStorage`, `ParametersStorage`): network operators bump\n *     `chainResetMarker` in the network config so daemons auto-wipe\n *     their derived chain state on next start, the on-chain Hub\n *     re-points consumers (`KnowledgeAssetsV10`, `ContextGraphs`) at\n *     this contract, and the publisher fleet re-creates conviction\n *     accounts under the new wrapper. PR #650 ships the\n *     `chainResetMarker` bump alongside this storage contract; do\n *     NOT deploy the new PCA stack against a network without the\n *     accompanying marker bump. See `network/testnet.json` and the\n *     PR body's \"Migration / fresh-state reset\" section.\n *   - `PublishingConviction` (the new logic contract) holds zero\n *     application state \u2014 only Hub-resolved contract references and\n *     metadata. It reads/writes here via `onlyContracts`-gated mutators\n *     and runs every business rule (account creation, billing-window\n *     settlement, lazy passive-sink sweeps, post-expiry final sweep, and\n *     active-sink epoch distribution).\n *   - `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT` keeps only the ERC-721 surface\n *     (mint/burn, transfer hook, ownership checks), the\n *     `_nextAccountId` mint counter, and the publisher-facing TRAC\n *     `transferFrom` paths. Every state read/write goes through this\n *     storage contract.\n *\n * Storage independence (the architectural goal):\n *   - The logic contract can be redeployed without touching account or\n *     agent state \u2014 Hub re-registers the new logic address, the storage\n *     keeps every existing `accounts[id]`, `topUpBalance[id]`,\n *     `windowSpent[id][w]`, and agent registration intact.\n *   - The NFT wrapper can also be redeployed (e.g. ERC-721 metadata\n *     surface change), at the cost of resetting `_nextAccountId` \u2014\n *     existing accounts keep their state but new mints would clash if\n *     the counter resets, so this is an upgrade path that requires care.\n *\n * State boundaries (what does NOT live here):\n *   - `_nextAccountId` \u2014 stays on the NFT wrapper because it is tightly\n *     coupled to ERC-721 mint ordering; the wrapper increments and\n *     supplies the new id to the logic contract on each `createAccount`\n *     forward (mirrors `DKGStakingConvictionNFT.nextTokenId`).\n *   - TRAC vault custody \u2014 TRAC sits in `ConvictionStakingStorage`\n *     (the V10 vault, post-v4.0.0 consolidation). This storage contract\n *     never holds TRAC and never moves it. The NFT wrapper drives\n *     `transferFrom(publisher \u2192 CSS)` directly on `createAccount` /\n *     `topUp`; this storage only updates the bookkeeping that controls\n *     how that escrowed TRAC eventually flows to staker pools via\n *     `EpochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange`.\n *\n * Caller gates:\n *   - Mutating functions are `onlyContracts` \u2014 only Hub-registered\n *     contracts (in practice `PublishingConviction`, with the NFT\n *     wrapper as a fallback for direct-write paths if ever needed) can\n *     invoke them.\n *   - `setMaxAgentsPerAccount` is `onlyHubOwner` because it is a\n *     governance-side parameter (mirrors `setStatus` / parameter\n *     setters on other V10 storage contracts).\n *\n * Invariants enforced inside this contract:\n *   - `agentToAccountId[agent] == accountId` iff\n *     `_isRegisteredAgent[accountId][agent] == true`. Agent register /\n *     deregister / clear-all paths flip both flags atomically so the\n *     two views never drift.\n *   - `_registeredAgents[accountId]` always equals the set of `agent`s\n *     for which `_isRegisteredAgent[accountId][agent] == true`. The\n *     swap-and-pop in `removeAgent` keeps the array in sync.\n */\ncontract PublishingConvictionStorage is INamed, IVersioned, HubDependent, IInitializable {\n    string private constant _NAME = \"PublishingConvictionStorage\";\n    // 1.0.0 \u2014 initial split-out from `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT` v2.0.0.\n    //         Identical state shape; no semantic changes.\n    // 10.0.3 \u2014 OT-RFC-51 \"Publishing Allocation\": `Account` gains\n    //          `primaryNode` + `lastPrimaryNodeChangeEpoch`, with the\n    //          `setPrimaryNodeData` onlyContracts setter.\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.3\";\n\n    /// @notice Default cap on registered agents per account, applied on\n    ///         first `initialize()` so a fresh deploy has a sane bound\n    ///         even before a HubOwner explicitly tunes it.\n    uint256 internal constant _DEFAULT_MAX_AGENTS_PER_ACCOUNT = 100;\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                     Account record\n    // ============================================================\n    //\n    // Field semantics (mirrors the legacy v2.x struct exactly so account\n    // state migrates 1:1 from the NFT):\n    //   - committedTRAC          : original commit at creation. Never\n    //                              changes after `createAccount`.\n    //   - createdAtEpoch         : Chronos epoch the account was created\n    //                              in (informational; not used for math).\n    //   - expiresAtEpoch         : first chain epoch past the account's\n    //                              lock (exclusive upper bound for\n    //                              `getRemainingAllowance`).\n    //   - createdAtTimestamp     : wall-clock anchor; billing windows\n    //                              are computed relative to this.\n    //   - expiresAtTimestamp     : `createdAtTimestamp +\n    //                              lockDurationEpochs * epochLength`.\n    //   - lockDurationEpochs     : number of billing windows the account\n    //                              spans (also the number of base-budget\n    //                              slices `committedTRAC` is divided into).\n    //   - discountBps            : 6-tier discount fixed at creation;\n    //                              top-ups do NOT change it.\n    //   - lastSettledWindow      : next unsettled billing-window index\n    //                              (exclusive of the highest already-swept\n    //                              window). Drives the lazy-settlement loop.\n    //   - fullySwept             : terminal flag. True once the post-expiry\n    //                              final sweep has accounted leftover\n    //                              top-up + dust to the staker pool. Acts\n    //                              as a re-entry guard.\n    struct Account {\n        uint96 committedTRAC;\n        uint40 createdAtEpoch;\n        uint40 expiresAtEpoch;\n        uint40 createdAtTimestamp;\n        uint40 expiresAtTimestamp;\n        uint16 lockDurationEpochs;\n        uint16 discountBps;\n        uint16 lastSettledWindow;\n        bool fullySwept;\n        // OT-RFC-51 \"Publishing Allocation\": the node this account's\n        // committed PCA budget is credited to as publishing allocation\n        // (K_n). `0` means no designated node (no allocation seeded).\n        uint72 primaryNode; // designated node identityId; 0 = none\n        // Rate-limit cursor for `setPrimaryNode`: re-designation is allowed\n        // at most once per chain epoch (require currentEpoch > this value).\n        uint40 lastPrimaryNodeChangeEpoch; // re-designation rate-limit cursor\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                       Events\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @notice Emitted when the governance-tunable agent cap changes.\n    event MaxAgentsPerAccountUpdated(uint256 oldCap, uint256 newCap);\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                        Errors\n    // ============================================================\n\n    error AccountAlreadyExists(uint256 accountId);\n    error UnknownAccount(uint256 accountId);\n    error AgentAlreadyRegistered(address agent, uint256 existingAccountId);\n    error AgentNotRegistered(uint256 accountId, address agent);\n    error TopUpUnderflow(uint256 accountId, uint96 amount, uint96 balance);\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                       State\n    // ============================================================\n\n    mapping(uint256 => Account) public accounts;\n\n    /// @notice Per-billing-window TRAC drawn against the current\n    ///         account's base allowance. Second key is the billing-window\n    ///         index (0-based, relative to `Account.createdAtTimestamp`);\n    ///         it is NOT a chain-epoch number. The base allowance per\n    ///         window is `committedTRAC / lockDurationEpochs`; a window's\n    ///         entry is bounded by that value.\n    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint40 => uint96)) public windowSpent;\n\n    /// @notice Persistent top-up buffer per account (NOT per-window).\n    ///         Drained only when the current window's base allowance is\n    ///         exhausted. Any non-zero balance at account expiry is swept\n    ///         to the staker pool by the final-sweep path.\n    mapping(uint256 => uint96) public topUpBalance;\n\n    /// @notice Per-account agent enumeration. Kept as an array so the\n    ///         transfer hook on the NFT wrapper can iterate and clear\n    ///         every registration in one call. The agent-side reverse\n    ///         map is `agentToAccountId`.\n    mapping(uint256 => address[]) internal _registeredAgents;\n\n    /// @notice Reverse map exposed publicly so external callers\n    ///         (`KnowledgeAssetsV10`, `ContextGraphs`) can resolve a\n    ///         publishing-agent address to its paying account id without\n    ///         caller-supplied authorization. The \"not registered\"\n    ///         sentinel is `0`, which is why `_nextAccountId` on the NFT\n    ///         starts at 1.\n    mapping(address => uint256) public agentToAccountId;\n\n    /// @notice Membership index that lets `coverPublishingCost` /\n    ///         `deregisterAgent` decide whether an `agent` is registered\n    ///         under `accountId` in O(1) without scanning\n    ///         `_registeredAgents[accountId]`.\n    mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => bool)) internal _isRegisteredAgent;\n\n    /// @notice Governance-tunable cap on `_registeredAgents[accountId].length`.\n    ///         Initialized to `_DEFAULT_MAX_AGENTS_PER_ACCOUNT` on the\n    ///         first `initialize()`; a HubOwner can retune via\n    ///         `setMaxAgentsPerAccount`.\n    uint256 public maxAgentsPerAccount;\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress) HubDependent(hubAddress) {}\n\n    /// @dev `initialize()` is idempotent across redeploys: the first call\n    ///      seeds `maxAgentsPerAccount` to the default; subsequent calls\n    ///      (e.g. post-upgrade) preserve whatever value the HubOwner has\n    ///      tuned it to.\n    function initialize() external onlyHub {\n        if (maxAgentsPerAccount == 0) {\n            maxAgentsPerAccount = _DEFAULT_MAX_AGENTS_PER_ACCOUNT;\n        }\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                  Account read helpers\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @notice Return the full `Account` record by id. Reverts if the\n    ///         account has never been created (sentinel:\n    ///         `lockDurationEpochs == 0` because every real account\n    ///         carries at least one billing window).\n    function getAccount(uint256 accountId) external view returns (Account memory) {\n        Account memory a = accounts[accountId];\n        if (a.lockDurationEpochs == 0) revert UnknownAccount(accountId);\n        return a;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Existence check used by callers that only need to know\n    ///         whether an account record is populated (e.g. the public\n    ///         `settle()` short-circuit). Returns `false` for any\n    ///         accountId that has never been minted.\n    function accountExists(uint256 accountId) external view returns (bool) {\n        return accounts[accountId].lockDurationEpochs != 0;\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                  Account write helpers\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @notice Persist a brand-new `Account` record. coverPublishingCost(address,uint96,uint4.details: Authorization (N28-fixed):        - `onlyConvictionNFT`: this function may only be invoked by          the NFT wrapper. KAV10 calls the NFT, the NFT validates          KAV10 as the outer caller, and the NFT forwards here.        - The publishing agent's accountId is resolved from PCS's          `agentToAccountId` map; KAV10 cannot pass a victim's          accountId.      Behavior — preserved 1:1 from the legacy stateful NFT:        1. Reject if the publish's KA lifetime (`kaEpochs`) exceeds           the account's `lockDurationEpochs`.        2. Lazily settle elapsed billing windows (passive sink).        3. Compute `discountedCost = baseCost * (1 - discountBps/1e4)`.        4. Spend order against the current window: base allowance           first, then `topUpBalance` overflow.        5. Distribute the discounted cost across the KA's epoch           range via `EpochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange` —           prorating the partial first and last chain epoch.      Does NOT physically move TRAC; the escrowed amount is already      in the CSS vault from `createAccount` / `topUp`. Returns the      discounted amount for KAV10's internal accounting.

createAccount(address,uint256,uint96,uin.details: Called by `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT.createAccount` AFTER it      has allocated `accountId` from its own monotonic mint counter      and minted the ERC-721 to `publisher`. The wrapper handles the      TRAC `transferFrom(publisher → ConvictionStakingStorage)`      itself; this function only writes accounting state.      Mint-then-write ordering matters for the transfer hook on the      NFT wrapper: by the time the transfer hook runs (mint case      `from == address(0)`), the storage record has been populated.      The hook short-circuits on mint/burn so this ordering is fine.      `lockDurationEpochs` is fixed by the protocol-wide      `parametersStorage.publishingConvictionEpochs()` setting at      creation. The discount tier is set once from the 6-tier      ladder applied to `committedTRAC`; subsequent top-ups do NOT      change the tier or extend the expiry.

initialize().details: Wires every Hub-registered dependency. Reverts on any      missing slot so a half-initialized deploy is impossible      (mirrors the legacy stateful NFT's defensive checks).

onTransfer(uint256,address,address).details: `from`/`to` arguments are not used internally — the         wrapper passes them so a future audit-friendly extension         (e.g. emitting a wrapper-layer transfer-settle event with         both endpoints) does not require an interface change.

registerAgent(address,uint256,address).details: Owner-validation lives on the NFT wrapper, which calls         this function with `owner` for symmetry with future         audit-friendly extensions. The argument is intentionally         unused here to avoid double-validating ownership across         contracts.

setPrimaryNode(uint256,uint72).details: Called by the NFT wrapper after it has validated `msg.sender ==      ownerOf(accountId)`.      Rules (OT-RFC-51):        - Rate-limited to at most once per chain epoch          (`currentEpoch > acct.lastPrimaryNodeChangeEpoch`).        - The NEW node must exist in the sharding table; the OLD node is          NOT re-validated (it may have exited the table since seeding).        - Only FUTURE epochs `e >= currentEpoch + 1` (within the lock)          are moved. Past/current epochs stay credited to the old node,          preserving already-realized scoring windows.        - Per-epoch amounts are recomputed from the SAME stored-field          schedule used at seeding, so each `move` byte-matches the seed          and the epoch total (K_total) is unchanged.

settle(uint256).details: Flow:        - Pre-expiry: sweeps every elapsed billing window's unspent          base remainder (`B - windowSpent[w]`) into the staker          pool, prorated across the chain epochs the window          overlaps.        - Post-expiry: in addition to the above, finalises the          last window, sweeps any leftover `topUpBalance`, and          sweeps `committedTRAC % lockDurationEpochs` dust to the          final chain epoch. Sets `fullySwept = true`.      No `onlyConvictionNFT` gate — public on purpose. Accounts      that have never been created revert via PCS's      `getAccount(...)` underflow path. `fullySwept` accounts      short-circuit before any work.

topUp(address,uint256,uint96).details: TRAC `transferFrom(owner → CSS vault)` happens on the NFT      wrapper, not here. We only update accounting state.

AccountExpired(uint256,uint40).notice: The conviction account is past `expiresAtEpoch` and can no         longer fund publishes.

InsufficientAllowance(uint256,uint40,uin.notice: The resolved conviction account cannot cover the (discounted)         cost for `epoch` — its base allowance plus top-up buffer fall         short of `required`.

PrimaryNodeChangeRateLimited(uint256,uin.notice: OT-RFC-51: `setPrimaryNode` called more than once in the same         chain epoch (rate-limit: at most once per epoch).

PrimaryNodeNotInShardingTable(uint72).notice: OT-RFC-51: a designated `primaryNode` is not in the sharding table.

PrimaryNodeUnchanged(uint256,uint72).notice: OT-RFC-51: `setPrimaryNode` called with `newNode` equal to the         current `primaryNode`. A no-op re-designation would still burn         the once-per-epoch change slot, emit a spurious         `PrimaryNodeChanged`, and run a pointless self-move loop — so it         is rejected.

ZeroPrimaryNode().notice: OT-RFC-51: `setPrimaryNode` called with `newNode == 0`. There is         no "clear designation" semantic — `primaryNode == 0` can only         mean never-seeded. Clearing would desync the stored node from         the still-seeded future buckets and let a later re-designation         double-credit `K_n`/`K_total` (which has no decrement path).

AccountFinalSwept(uint256,uint96,uint96).notice: Emitted once per account, when the post-expiry final sweep         finishes (base remainder + topUp buffer + dust all accounted).

PrimaryNodeChanged(uint256,uint72,uint72.notice: OT-RFC-51: emitted when an account's designated primary node         changes (including the initial designation at creation, where         `oldNode == 0`).

WindowSettled(uint256,uint40,uint40,uint.notice: Emitted for each elapsed billing window that gets swept to         the staker pool via the passive sink during lazy settlement.

STAKER_SHARD_ID().notice: EpochStorage shard ID for the staker reward pool. Mirrors         the constant on `KnowledgeAssetsV10` and the legacy         stateful NFT so reward-distribution semantics are identical.

chronos().notice: Chronos drives both the chain-epoch cursor (`getCurrentEpoch`,         `epochAtTimestamp`, `timestampForEpoch`) and the billing-         window length (`epochLength`). Billing windows align in         duration to chain epochs but are anchored at the account's         creation timestamp, not at chain-epoch boundaries.

convictionStakingStorage().notice: The V10 TRAC vault. Escrowed conviction TRAC         (`committedTRAC` + top-ups) physically lives here; the         only outflow is `transferStake`. Used to pay the protocol         treasury fee out of the escrow when it is skimmed from a         staker-bound amount.

coverPublishingCost(address,uint96,uint4.notice: Charge a publishing agent's conviction allowance for         `baseCost` and fund the published KA's epoch range from         the escrowed TRAC sitting in the CSS vault.

createAccount(address,uint256,uint96,uin.notice: Persist the `Account` record for a freshly-minted NFT.

deregisterAgent(address,uint256,address).notice: Remove `agent` from `accountId`. PCS reverts if not         registered.

epochStorage().notice: EpochStorage is the cross-V10 active/passive sink: every         TRAC distribution to the staker reward pool flows through         `addTokensToEpochRange(STAKER_SHARD_ID, ...)`.

getCurrentBillingWindow(uint256).notice: Public view: current billing-window index, capped at         `lockDurationEpochs` (i.e. "no more active windows").

getDiscountBps(uint96).notice: Discrete 6-tier discount ladder. Tiers are evaluated         highest-first so the largest commit that qualifies is         selected.

getRemainingAllowance(uint256,uint40).notice: Remaining allowance (base + topUp) for `accountId` in         a given chain `epoch`. Returns 0 outside the account's         active lifetime.

getWindowChainEpochRange(uint256,uint40).notice: Public view: chain-epoch range that billing-window `w`         of `accountId` overlaps. Useful for off-chain reporting.

onTransfer(uint256,address,address).notice: Trigger lazy-settlement from the NFT wrapper's transfer         hook AND clear every agent registration so the new owner         starts with a clean slate. Restricted to the NFT.

parametersStorage().notice: ParametersStorage exposes the protocol-wide         `publishingConvictionEpochs` setting that fixes         `Account.lockDurationEpochs` at creation time.

publishingConvictionStorage().notice: Application-state store for every conviction account.         Resolved once at `initialize()` from Hub; can be         replaced by Hub re-registration in a future upgrade         without touching this contract's own (empty) state.

registerAgent(address,uint256,address).notice: Append `agent` to `accountId`. Cap, zero-address, and         already-registered checks are enforced here; PCS         performs the atomic write.

setPrimaryNode(uint256,uint72).notice: Re-designate the primary node for `accountId`, moving FUTURE         epochs' publishing allocation from the old node to the new one.

settle(uint256).notice: Public lazy-settlement entry point. Permissionless: anyone         (account owner, staker pool watcher, automation bot) can         flush pending sweeps. Idempotent — subsequent calls after         the post-expiry final sweep are no-ops.

shardingTableStorage().notice: OT-RFC-51: used to validate that a designated `primaryNode`         exists in the sharding table before any publishing allocation         is seeded onto it (`createAccount`) or moved to it         (`setPrimaryNode`). Mirrors the `nodeExists` gate KAV10 used         to apply on realized-publishing attribution.

topUp(address,uint256,uint96).notice: Settle elapsed windows then bump the persistent top-up         buffer. NFT wrapper owns ownership validation; this         function only enforces "amount > 0" and "not expired".

userdoc.notice: Stateless V10 logic contract for publisher conviction accounts. V10 split-contract architecture (mirrors the staking-side `StakingV10` / `ConvictionStakingStorage` / `DKGStakingConvictionNFT` trio):   - `PublishingConvictionStorage` (PCS) holds every byte of state:     `Account` records, `windowSpent[id][w]`, `topUpBalance[id]`,     agent registrations, and the governance cap.   - This contract holds NO application state — only Hub-resolved     contract references and metadata constants. Every business rule     (account creation, lazy passive-sink settlement, post-expiry     final sweep, active-sink epoch distribution, agent register /     deregister, transfer-hook agent clear) lives here. The contract     can be redeployed and re-registered on Hub without touching any     account state.   - `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT` (the NFT wrapper) keeps only the     ERC-721 surface, the `_nextAccountId` mint counter, and the     publisher-facing TRAC `transferFrom` paths. Every state read /     write goes through PCS. Lazy-settlement model (preserved 1:1 from the legacy stateful NFT):   - Each account lifetime is divided into `lockDurationEpochs` billing     windows of length `Chronos.epochLength()`, anchored at     `Account.createdAtTimestamp`. Per-window base budget is     `B = committedTRAC / lockDurationEpochs`.   - Two sinks drain `B` per window:       1. ACTIVE: `coverPublishingCost` distributes its          `discountedCost` across the published KA's epoch range via          `EpochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange`. The base portion drawn          increments `windowSpent[id][w]`, capped at `B`.       2. PASSIVE: at the end of window `w`, the unspent remainder          `B - windowSpent[w]` is swept to the staker reward pool for          the chain epochs that window overlaps. Settlement is lazy:          triggered by the next `coverPublishingCost`, `topUp`,          ERC-721 transfer (via `onTransfer`), or an explicit public          `settle(accountId)` call.   - `topUpBalance[accountId]` is a separate prepaid usage buffer     beyond the base budget. It is drawn only when the current     window's base allowance is exhausted. Any leftover at account     expiry is swept to the staker pool (final chain epoch) via the     same `settle()` path.   - Invariant: over a full account lifetime, the total TRAC drained     from the escrowed `committedTRAC + sum(topUps)` is conserved and     splits into exactly two destinations:       (a) the staker reward pool, credited via           `EpochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange(STAKER_SHARD_ID, ...)`, and       (b) the protocol treasury, paid via           `ConvictionStakingStorage.transferStake(protocolTreasury, fee)`.     The treasury fee (`ParametersStorage.protocolTreasuryFee`, bps) is     skimmed from every staker-bound amount — the active-sink     distribution, each passive window sweep, and the final dust/topUp     tail — so `pool + treasury == committedTRAC + sum(topUps)` still     holds. While `protocolTreasury == address(0)` the fee is 0 and the     whole amount flows to the pool (legacy behaviour). Any     `committedTRAC % lockDurationEpochs` dust is swept on the final     settle alongside the topUp tail. Caller gates:   - Mutating entry points driven by user actions are     `onlyConvictionNFT` — only the Hub-registered     `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT` can invoke them. The wrapper passes     `msg.sender` (the publisher / owner / KAV10 publishing-agent     resolver) explicitly so this contract never trusts `tx.origin`.   - `coverPublishingCost` additionally enforces N28: KAV10 calls the     NFT, the NFT forwards here with the publishing agent's address,     and we resolve the paying account via PCS's `agentToAccountId`.     A trusted caller cannot pass a victim's accountId.   - `settle(accountId)` is intentionally permissionless — any account     (including a staker pool watcher) can flush pending sweeps. The     account's `fullySwept` flag short-circuits redundant work.
